description: Hawaiʻi voters deserve to hear directly from both candidates before ballots arrive. They deserve to ask the tough questions, hear our positions, and make an informed decision about the future of our state. The people of Hawai'i need to know the strength and character of their future leaders for themselves. Before ballots arrive, Hawaiʻi deserves to hear from both of us. People of Hawaiʻi, join us in this petition calling for a debate.
